content: Dr. Pat Simmons, born on November 21, 1974, in Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan, is a Canadian curler. He served as the skip for Team Saskatchewan in four consecutive Brier tournaments from 2005 to 2008. In 2005, Simmons participated in his first Brier after securing his inaugural provincial championship. During this tournament, he led Saskatchewan to a 6-5 record, resulting in a four-way tie for fifth place, but the team did not advance to the playoffs. In the 2006 Brier, Simmons once again skipped Saskatchewan, finishing with a 5-6 record. This performance placed the team in a tie for eighth place, leaving them out of playoff contention. The 2007 Brier saw an improvement in Simmons' performance, as he guided Saskatchewan to a 7-4 record. However, despite the better outcome, the team narrowly missed the playoffs, finishing in fifth place. Finally, in the 2008 Brier, Simmons successfully led Saskatchewan to a playoff position. The team concluded the round-robin stage in second place with an impressive 9-2 record.
